scenes.title: The comfort of certainty
scenes.viewerPurpose: Make explanatory relief potentially premature; Name the moment when a story becomes assumed reality; Give everyday situations that rapidly attract explanations
scenes.composition: Let a relieved person settle on a quick explanation while one unanswered detail stays visible. Show later notes beginning to gather under that first explanation. Introduce a broken appliance and one plausible explanation before any inspection has occurred.

scenes.title: What makes a story testable?
scenes.viewerPurpose: Separate felt understanding from causal knowledge; Move from private judgments to institutions and AI; Ask what remains excluded or revisable
scenes.composition: Keep the explanation separate from the appliance's still-hidden cause. Place a work decision and an AI answer beside the same unexamined assumption. Open space for a second possible cause and an observation that could distinguish them.
